description: A link that opens the aipromodesign.com designer with the design already on the item in that color and, when sizes are given, the order lines filled in. The customer finishes there: more edits with the designer's own tools, other print areas, names and numbers, sizes collected from a group, and checkout. Use it when the customer is ready to order or wants to keep working. Nothing is charged by opening it.

color.description: Defaults to the color the design was made for.

design_id.description: The design_id from that design's earlier result. If that result is no longer in the conversation, leave this out to use the customer's most recent design.

item.description: Item key or the word a customer would use (tee, hoodie, mug, tote, cap, polo, long sleeve, crewneck, performance tee, women's tee, youth hoodie, notebook, tumbler). Use list_items for the full set. Defaults to the item the design was made for.

sizes.description: Count per size, when the customer has said. Leave out to open the designer without an order line.

visitor.description: The visitor value from an earlier answer, if there was one.

name: open_in_studio
title: Continue on aipromodesign.com
